name: Street Intervention Before–After Preferences (GSV Time Travel)
description: Visual stated-preference survey from Lopes, Valença & Moura (2026, Landscape and Urban Planning 273, 105686; 188 participants). Each participant gets one of four blocks of eight real street interventions (2 car-oriented, 2 bus-oriented, 4 active-modes; 3 medium, 3 large, 2 transformative), each shown as a pair of 360° Google Street View panoramas from before and after the change, in random A/B order. For each pair they look around, answer "Please select the urban environment you prefer." and "Do you know this place?", and rate how much seven factors (usefulness, safety, security, stress, comfort, order, liveability) influenced the choice, followed by socio-demographic and travel-behaviour questions. The 28 interventions (Lisbon, Barcelona, Auckland, Brussels, New York, San Francisco and 12 other cities) and the block structure are the authors' own, taken from their public list; question wording is taken from the paper and the authors' public dataset (github.com/mariaines0/preferences_urban_interventions). Analysis as in the paper: share preferring the "after" view per intervention and group, and a pooled logistic regression on after-preferred (use trial_k.code or site to identify the intervention). Differences from the original study: (1) the original embedded live, navigable Street View; here each view is a 360° strip at eye level that can be turned left and right (both views turn together) but not moved along the street or tilted; (2) Google has retired some of the original panoramas, so 23 of the 56 views use the panorama at the same spot closest to the authors' date (16 within the same month, the largest gap is Mexico City: before view 13 months earlier, after view 10 months later; see sources.json in the project notes); (3) the labels of the 5-point factor scale and several answer lists (gender, occupation, commute modes, commute time, parking) are not published, so those use our own options or free text, and multiple-choice items (pets, disabilities, role) are single choice. Street images © Google. If the authors or Google object, the images will be taken down.
author: Lopes, Valença & Moura

elements.name: consent
elements.title: I agree to take part. My answers are recorded anonymously for research.

elements.name: block
elements.title: Block of eight interventions (1–4), assigned at random by the page
elements.description: The original survey had four blocks of eight before/after pairs (2 car-oriented, 2 bus-oriented, 4 active-modes; 3 medium, 3 large, 2 transformative); each participant saw one block at random.

elements.name: trial_1
elements.title: Street 1: which intervention was shown and how
elements.description: Value: {block, code (survey code G101–G408), site (authors' intervention ID), city, country, type (car / bus / active), scale, view_a, view_b (which of before/after was shown as A and as B, random), chosen, after_preferred (1 = post-intervention view preferred, the paper's Y), looked_around, seconds}. Use code or site to analyse by intervention.

elements.name: pref_1
elements.title: Please select the urban environment you prefer.
elements.description: Verbatim preference question; forced choice. Participants see the two views as A and B in random order, never the words before/after.

elements.name: know_1
elements.title: Do you know this place?
elements.description: Verbatim familiarity question.

elements.name: factors_1
elements.title: Evaluate to what extent the following factors have influenced your decision.
elements.description: Value: {usefulness, safety, security, stress, comfort, order, liveability}, each 1–5. Wording of the question and of the seven factors is taken from the authors' public dataset; the labels of the five scale points are not published (here 1 = not at all, 5 = very much).

:root{--bg:#f2f1ed;--card:#fff;--ink:#1d1e21;--muted:#5d6066;--accent:#2456a6;--accent-ink:#fff;--line:#d9d6cf;--warn:#b3261e}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:920px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px 40px}h1{font-size:1.3rem;margin:0 0 8px}p{margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 20px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent)}.btn.sm{padding:7px 12px;font-size:.9rem}.btn.sel{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px;align-items:center}
.q{margin-top:16px}.q>b{display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600}
textarea,input[type=text],input[type=number]{width:100%;font:inherit;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}input[type=number]{width:140px}
label.o{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer}
.step{display:inline-block;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#e1e9f7;color:#1b3f7a;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
.sheet{position:relative;border:1px solid #bdb9b0;background:#fffdf8;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none}
.sheet canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;cursor:crosshair;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.sheet input{position:absolute;width:150px;padding:3px 6px;font-size:.85rem;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:6px;z-index:2}
.tools{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin:8px 0}
.clock{margin-left:auto;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.compass{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,56px);gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
.compass button{height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-size:1.2rem;cursor:pointer}.compass button.sel{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.legend{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}.legend i{display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:-1px}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:920px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
.vw{position:relative;margin-top:10px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.pano{height:300px;background-repeat:repeat-x;background-size:auto 100%;cursor:grab;touch-action:pan-y;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.tag{position:absolute;left:10px;top:10px;z-index:2;background:#fff;color:#111;font-weight:700;border-radius:8px;padding:2px 12px;font-size:1.1rem;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
#pick .btn{flex:1;min-width:130px;font-size:1.05rem}
.fhead{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:16px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
.frow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.93rem}
.fb{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-shrink:0}.fb button{width:34px;height:34px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.fb button.sel{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
@media(max-width:700px){.pano{height:190px}.frow{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}}
</style>

    app.querySelectorAll('#pick button').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){choice=b.getAttribute('data-c');app.querySelectorAll('#pick button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('sel',x===b);});err('');};});
    app.querySelectorAll('#know button').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){know=b.getAttribute('data-k');app.querySelectorAll('#know button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('sel',x===b);});err('');};});
    app.querySelectorAll('.fb').forEach(function(g){g.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){F[g.getAttribute('data-f')]=Number(b.getAttribute('data-n'));g.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('sel',x===b);});err('');};});});
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      if(!choice)return err('Please choose the urban environment you prefer, A or B.');
      if(!know)return err('Please say whether you know this place.');
      for(var i=0;i<FACTORS.length;i++)if(!F[FACTORS[i][0]])return err('Please rate: '+FACTORS[i][1].split(' (')[0]+'.');
      var chosen=choice==='A'?topIs:botIs,shown=[files[topIs],files[botIs]];
      var items=[['trial_'+k,{block:Number(A.block),code:code,site:S.id,city:S.city,country:S.country,type:S.type,scale:S.scale,view_a:topIs,view_b:botIs,chosen:chosen,after_preferred:chosen==='after'?1:0,looked_around:panned,seconds:Math.round((Date.now()-t0)/100)/10},{shown:shown}],
        ['pref_'+k,chosen,{shown:shown}],['know_'+k,know],['factors_'+k,F]],o=document.getElementById('other').value.trim();
      if(o)items.push(['other_'+k,o]);
      saveAll(items,this,next);};}
  function form(P){
    var h='<div class="card"><span class="step">'+esc(P.step)+'</span>';
    P.names.forEach(function(n){var q=SPSite.getQuestion(n);h+='<div class="q"><b>'+esc(T(n))+(req(n)?'':' <span style="font-weight:400;color:#777">(optional)</span>')+'</b>';
      if(q.type==='radiogroup')h+=q.choices.map(function(c){return '<label class="o"><input type="radio" name="'+n+'" value="'+esc(c.value)+'"> '+esc(c.text)+'</label>';}).join('');
      else if(q.type==='comment')h+='<textarea id="f_'+n+'" style="min-height:60px"></textarea>';
      else h+='<input id="f_'+n+'" type="'+(q.kind==='number'?'number':'text')+'"'+(q.kind==='number'?' min="0" max="600"':'')+'>';
      h+='</div>';});
    app.innerHTML=h+'<div class="row"><button class="btn" id="go">Continue</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){var items=[];
      for(var k=0;k<P.names.length;k++){var n=P.names[k],q=SPSite.getQuestion(n),x;
        if(q.type==='radiogroup'){var c=app.querySelector('input[name="'+n+'"]:checked');x=c?c.value:'';}
        else{x=document.getElementById('f_'+n).value.trim();if(q.kind==='number'&&x!==''){x=Number(x);if(isNaN(x)||x<0||x>600)return err('Please enter a valid number.');}}
        if(req(n)&&x==='')return err('Please answer: '+T(n).slice(0,80)+(T(n).length>80?'…':''));
        if(x!=='')items.push([n,x]);}
      saveAll(items,this,next);};}
  function finish(){
    var n=0;for(var k=1;k<=8;k++)if(A['pref_'+k]==='after')n++;
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p>Each street was shown before and after a real change to how its space is shared: some changes gave more room to walking and cycling, some to buses, and some to cars. You preferred the street <b>after</b> the change in '+n+' of 8 cases. In the original study by Lopes, Valença and Moura (2026), most participants preferred the "after" view, especially for changes in favour of walking and cycling.</p><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');return;}var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your answers have been saved. You can close this window now.';});}
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){A=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};(SPSite.getMedia('sites')||[]).forEach(function(f){MEDIA[f.name]=f;});next();});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: Eight real street interventions, each shown as a pair of 360° Google Street View panoramas from before and after the change. Participants look around both views, choose the urban environment they prefer, say whether they know the place and rate seven factors behind the choice.

paper.title: Exploring Before-and-After visual preferences of street interventions using Google Street View time travel
